prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the best one for you depends on your goals, budget, company stage, industry, and which channels you need (SEO, PPC, social, content, CRO, analytics, creative, etc.). I can recommend agencies, but first it helps to know more about what you need.

Quick questions
- What are your top goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, fundraising, etc.)
- What services do you need? (SEO, paid ads, content, social, email, analytics, creative/UX)
- Company size and stage? (startup, scaleup, enterprise)
- Monthly marketing budget (ad spend + agency fees) or expected retainer range?
- Any industry focus or compliance needs (SaaS, fintech, health, B2B)?

How to pick an agency (fast checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies with measurable results in your industry or with similar KPIs.
- Clear process: discovery -> strategy -> execution -> measurement -> optimization.
- Team fit: access to senior strategists, not just junior execution.
- Reporting & KPIs: regular dashboards and agreed success metrics.
- Transparency: pricing, project scope, and what is/ isn’t included.
- References: ask for 2–3 recent client references.
- Cultural fit & communication cadence (time zone, tools, SLAs).

Typical agency archetypes and when to use them
- Large integrated agencies (e.g., global networks with SF offices): best for big brands, full-service creative + media + analytics, large budgets.
- Mid-size performance agencies: good for ROI-focused campaigns (PPC, paid social, CRO) and scaling revenue.
- Specialized agencies: great if you need deep expertise — SEO-only, B2B demand gen, paid-social, creative studios.
- Small/local or boutique: better for startups that need hands-on strategic support and cost flexibility.

Ballpark fees (very general)
- Freelancers/consultants: $50–200+/hr or project fees.
- Small agencies: $3k–15k/month retainer.
- Mid-size/performance: $10k–50k+/month.
- Large agencies/enterprise: $20k–200k+/month or big project fees.
(ad spend is usually additional and scales with goals)

Red flags
- Promises of fixed rankings or guaranteed conversions with no context.
- Opaque reporting or no access to raw data.
- High-pressure long-term contracts without performance milestones.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 San Francisco agencies tailored to your goals and budget (give me the details above), or
- Draft an RFP/email template you can send to agencies, or
- Provide a shortlist by category (enterprise creative, growth performance, B2B demand gen, SEO) with pros/cons.

Which would you like me to do?
